note: What a new home's data/ starts with, file by file. Everything that belongs to one household -- the voice on its speakers, its mod comments, its local memory model -- starts off, and is switched on under Settings or in these files when it is wanted.

voice.json.note: The local claude-voice speak server, if this machine has one. Off in a new home.

recall.json.note: The automatic memory: a small local model in LM Studio that suggests essences before each turn. null is none.

reach.json.note: Where the assistant may look with `files`. The code and its own home are always included. Read-only in every case.

plan.json.note: What subscription the assistant runs on, for it to see. Its owner keeps this current.
